summary: Customer wants in-line monitoring of sucrose concentration in a clear, colourless aqueous solution flowing through a 50 mm stainless steel pipe at 20–30 °C and normal pressure. Expected range 5–15 % w/w, quality limit ±0.3 % w/w, one reading per minute, lab refractometer retained as reference. Analyzer can be 10 m from pipe in dry safe room; line CIP with hot caustic once daily. They request a method and probe for a first trial.
